meta_description: Norvex NE is your trusted emergency plumber in Sunderland. Fast response, honest pricing, and expert repairs. Call us now for same-day service.
hero_subhead: Burst pipe or blocked drain in Sunderland? We're out within the hour, any time of day or night.
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to planned installations, we handle every plumbing challenge with speed and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Burst Pipes
services.desc: Burst or leaking pipes demand fast action. We locate the fault, stop the water, and repair or replace the damaged section — often the same day.

services.title: Boiler Repairs & Installation
services.desc: Cold radiators or a dead boiler can ruin your winter. We diagnose faults quickly and fit new energy-efficient models with 10-year guarantees.

services.title: Blocked Drains & Sewers
services.desc: Slow drains and foul smells need professional clearing. We use camera surveys and high-pressure jetting to clear blockages without damage.

services.title: Radiator & Heating Maintenance
services.desc: Annual servicing keeps your heating running safely and efficiently, reducing bills and preventing mid-winter breakdowns.

services.title: Leaking Taps & Toilets
services.desc: A dripping tap wastes thousands of litres yearly and hikes your bill. We replace seals and washers quickly, or fit new low-flow fixtures.

services.title: Bathroom & Kitchen Installation
services.desc: New bathroom suites, kitchen sinks, and wet rooms installed to building standards with all pipework hidden and tested.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I was fed up seeing overpriced emergency call-outs.
about_para_1: Norvex NE has served Sunderland's homes and businesses for 15 years. We began as a one-man outfit and have grown into a trusted local team without losing the personal touch that keeps customers coming back. Every job is treated with the same care, whether it's a £50 tap repair or a full heating system overhaul.
about_para_2: Our reputation is built on honesty: we quote upfront, don't add hidden charges, and turn up on time. Neighbours recommend us to each other because we actually solve problems rather than create new ones. When you call Norvex NE, you get a plumber who listens, explains the work clearly, and leaves your home as clean as we found it.
reviews_heading: What Sunderland Customers Say About Us

reviews.text: Had a burst pipe in the middle of the night before New Year. Called Norvex and they were at the house within 50 minutes. Dave diagnosed it straight away, got the water off, and had it patched up by morning. No faffing about, just straightforward honest work. Brilliant.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Our boiler packed in just before Christmas. I was dreading the cost, but the lad explained exactly what was wrong and gave us a fair price for a replacement. Fitted the next day, runs like a dream now, and they even showed us how to use the new controls. Top job.
reviews.author: Linda K.

reviews.text: Blocked drain at the rental house in Monkwearmouth. Rather than guess, they sent the camera down first, showed us the blockage on a tablet, and explained what they'd do. High-pressure jet sorted it in an hour. Professional throughout, and the invoice matched the quote exactly.
reviews.author: James R.
